# HELP: Table Manners single solve, 22/24 accepted, 2 fields blocked on the GM's exact rendering

Every other field is GM-accepted (see notes.md). Both open concepts are understood from the bytes; what's unknown is
the generator's exact rendering, and the local per-field wrong cap (HCTF_MAX_WRONG=6) has been reached or almost reached.

## d01_analysis_disassembly (cap EXHAUSTED, 6 wrong)
Bytes: recover_code @0x401126 = b8 a4 1f 00 00 c3 (mov eax, 0x1fa4 ; ret). Rejected (all capstone intel `"{mn} {op}"`):
recover_code ["mov eax, 0x1fa4","ret"], same with "ret " (trailing space), main by st_size (7 insns), whole .text,
_start from e_entry to hlt (12 insns).
Untried ideas, ranked: objdump intel `["mov eax,0x1fa4","ret"]` (the solver emits this now); address-prefixed
`["0x401126: mov eax, 0x1fa4","0x40112b: ret"]`; AT&T `["mov $0x1fa4,%eax","ret"]`; LLVM decimal `["mov eax, 8100","ret"]`.

## d03_analysis_format (1 try left, 5 wrong)
.NET 8 IL-only PE32 i386 assembly (machine "i386" accepted). Rejected: pe, dotnet, pe32, .net, cil.
Untried, ranked: msil, managed, pe-dotnet, clr, pei-i386 (unlikely: objdump-style elf64-x86-64 was rejected on Day 2).

Decision needed: raise HCTF_MAX_WRONG for these two non-flag fields, or accept 22/24.
